newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney, SEC in talks on Dade Cty, Fla. probe.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney, SEC in talks on Dade Cty, Fla. probe.

text.p: Smith Barney Inc said Friday it is in discussions with the Securities and Exchange Commission about "a possible resolution" of a probe into the firm's handling of a 1994 Dade County bond issue.

The firm has not received a Wells letter notifying it of any pending charges in the SEC's civil investigation, but has "made a written submission throught the SEC indicating why an enforcement action should not be brought," Smith Barney spokesman Bob Connor said.
"The firm and the SEC are discussing a possible resolution of the matter," Connor said.
SEC Regional Director Charles Senatore in Miami declined to comment.
Smith Barney also said the probe did not affect its ability to continue underwriting bonds for Dade County, whose mayor removed the firm from an upcoming bond issue because of the SEC probe Friday.
Smith Barney said the county commission had been fully apprised of the status of the probe.
